title: Minimalist design, easy to use
body: Perfect minimalist design, I hope you could add on another for “monthly” habit instead of just a weekly and daily ones. I’d like to track some personal monthly habit e.g. trying out a new recipe etc (would be a bit unrealistic for me to try it weekly due to work schedule). Hope you could consider this feature in your new update!
